description: Mungia wears an opaque muted teal floor-length gown or steppe coat-dress with a low square neckline, fitted bodice and an off-the-shoulder sleeve arrangement. Gold and teal geometric woven trim edges the neckline, cuffs and long overlapping skirt fronts. A cream underdress appears at the center below the waist. A broad woven gold-brown sash has a round silver-toned clasp and hanging cords with small ornaments and tassels. A pale cream wrap with matching teal and gold borders and fringed ends rests around her arms. Small drop earrings provide restrained jewelry. Brown embroidered ankle shoes show under the hem. Both black braids are uncovered.
